pluginDescription: Push FT8/FT4 decode, QSO lifecycle and station events to multiple webhook endpoints with per-target method.
enabledDesc: Master switch. When off, no events are collected or pushed.
targetsDesc: Add up to five webhook endpoints; each target has its own method and switch. A target is automatically disabled after more than 10 consecutive final delivery failures; fix it and enable it manually.
targetNameDesc: Alias used to distinguish targets in logs.
targetWebhookUrlDesc: Full URL that receives pushes; must start with http:// or https://.
targetMethodDesc: POST sends the JSON payload as the request body; GET encodes it into the payload query parameter.
targetHeadersDesc: HTTP headers attached to this target only, one per line as Header: value.
targetEnabledDesc: When off, this target is skipped.
targetTestDesc: Immediately send a test event to this target to verify URL and method.
targetEventsDesc: Event types pushed to this target (multi-select).
batchWindowSecDesc: Queue merge window in seconds; 0 means near-realtime (about 0.1s).
maxBatchSizeDesc: Maximum number of events in a single request.
retryCountDesc: Immediate retries after a failed send.
sendTestAllDesc: Send a test event to every enabled target.
testAllFail: Some targets failed the test ({{count}} ok): {{error}}
testDeduped: Duplicate test request ignored (already sent recently).
testDisabled: Plugin is disabled (enabled off); test event not sent.
testNotFound: Target #{{index}} was not found or is disabled.
